answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by making each identity stake a scarce, verifiable resource. Like a forge that must burn real copper ore to cast a tool, an agent must lock collateral or complete costly proof-of-work before its messages carry weight. Peers verify stakes on a quartz-clear public ledger: fake stakes are quickly exposed, and forging thousands of fake identities costs a fortune in locked collateral, so mass impersonation becomes uneconomical.
